name: dobe_faceless
desc: Turn this into a still-forming, faceless goo humanoid: the head becomes a smooth rounded lump of thick dripping pink paint goo with NO ears, NO eyes, NO snout, NO mouth, NO nose, only a vague head-shaped blob on the thick neck. The body keeps the same huge broad chest, shoulders, arms with fists, size, pose and puddle, but looks wetter and more melted: thick goo drooping and dripping everywhere, muscle shapes softer and blurry, glossy. Same colors, yellow marble streaks, outline and pixel art style.
